messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 18):
"""
4.5 Specify, any other underwriting criteria 4.6 Whether Underwriting of the product aligned to the Board Approved Underwriting policy of the Company Yes / No 4.7 Whether full costs of pre policy medical check-up are borne by the Insurer Yes / No 4.8 If no, specify the percentage proposed to be borne by the Insurer. 4.9 Waiting Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits Name of Cover or Plan or Option Waiting Period (in Days) 4.10 Survival Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits Name of Cover or Plan or Option Survival Period (in Days)
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Does the insurer have to cover the full cost of the pre‑policy medical check‑up for this health plan?","answer":"No, the insurer does not bear the full cost of the pre‑policy medical check‑up.","facts":["4.7 Whether full costs of pre policy medical check-up are borne by the Insurer Yes / No","4.7 Whether full costs of pre policy medical check-up are borne by the Insurer Yes / No"]},{"question":"What is the waiting period for the payment of benefits under the proposed health cover?","answer":"The waiting period is specified in the table under \"Waiting Period (in Days)\" for each cover or plan.","facts":["4.9 Waiting Periods in days proposed, if any, for payment of benefits Name of Cover or Plan or Option Waiting Period (in Days)"]}]}
